_meta.why: No WooPayments payment method reaches requires_action today: Stripe uses it only for refunds that need the customer's bank details (Konbini, PromptPay, Boleto, bank transfers; https://docs.stripe.com/refunds#requires-action), and WooPayments offers none of them. A real test-mode Multibanco refund returned pending, then succeeded.
sources: https://docs.stripe.com/api/refunds/object (status: pending, requires_action, succeeded, failed or canceled; next_action with type and display_details: email_sent.email_sent_at, email_sent.email_sent_to, expires_at; balance_transaction nullable)
https://docs.stripe.com/refunds#requires-action (next_action.type display_details; requires_action then pending then succeeded)
_meta.base: The refund POST answer recorded on local WPCOM for a test-mode Multibanco refund (store :8889, 2026-10-10, charge py_3UOxgVBzWlxcwgpP1cKazbgW, 3.00 EUR), with the expanded payment_intent reduced to its ID, then changed as listed in changes.
_meta.changes: id replaced; status pending to requires_action; pending_reason removed; balance_transaction set to null (no money has moved yet); metadata set to a hand-built marker and native's refund_source; next_action added in the documented shape, its email REDACTED and its timestamps hand-picked
_meta.sanitized: email_sent_to REDACTED; no keys, tokens or other emails
